chapter: Leading the band after Chick Webb, 1939-40
title: Reviving back-of-the-book arrangements
summary: Rehearsed arrangements stored in the book were pulled out when the band's spirit was high.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose

blocks.x: And we had a lot of arrangements like that. We used to rehearse (inaudible) arrangements sometimes and we put it in the back of the book.
And we be playing sometime and Chick will say, 'Let's go back.' That arrangement of (inaudible) Charlie Dixon, say, 'Let's pull it out, let's see what we could do with it tonight.'

Sometime the band would be up to extra -- you know, the spirit will be real high. We'd go back and get some of the things that we couldn't do anything with. Sometime we get something out of it that particular night. if give it a number (Inaudible) we did, we (Inaudible), Put it in the book and we'd play it.
